base_definition.rule: outs = [full, full] plus two roles per stage whose frame is the prefix up to the stage for I and the suffix from the stage for T; T counts 112 ports per role; the helper block is added at its own ranks

consequence: the invoiced census is the word's own diagonal census, so the census matches without any reinterpretation of the invoice
diagnosis: the invoice counts targets in the designed frame basis, and the factorisation diagonal of the controller word realises exactly that multiset.  An earlier reading used the row closure of the thinned matrix, which saturates and is not the target notion
